verdict.rationale: Secureframe's first-party docs describe running access reviews directly in the platform. User data is pulled from native and custom integrations, reviewers are designated per system, and recurring schedules and reminders drive the cycle. Reviewers decide in-app to maintain, modify, revoke, or mark access out of scope, and follow-up tasks sync to ticketing tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation that completed review sign-offs are stored as artifacts in the evidence library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
